title: Archenemy: Nicol Bolas Schemes: card flavor text

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon planeswalker who is the archenemy of this set; its flavor text is voiced by a tyrant who boasts of creating and destroying worlds.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas boasts that he has created entire worlds and extinguished twice as many.
events.quote: I have created entire worlds and extinguished twice as many.
